propositions: CLI reference documentation and distribution contracts must derive deterministically from committed parser artifacts and ROUTES registry enumeration, not hand-maintained command census or regex parsing
Generated command syntax/options sections must byte-match committed help output verified by gen_cli_help.py --check and gen_cli_reference.py --check across all Python versions
Manual INTERCEPT_COMMANDS, source regex parsing, and hand-curated command tables must be removed entirely; editorial prose must be structurally separated and linted against authoritative registry
Clean wheel builds with no optional extras must render all approved help forms with exact committed bytes and without importing operation/config/store/parser/handler modules
Full-extra validation must resolve every lazy handler/parser/selector reference and capability-to-extra mapping without executing command logic
Registry-derived tests must replace manual route unions; same repo-local commands must work locally and in portable CI; rebar-mcp entry point must be smoke-tested separately
